suspects.name: Vikram Malhotra
suspects.personality: Ambitious, outwardly calm, but prone to bursts of temper when cornered.
suspects.physicalDescription: A man in his mid-40s, with sharp features, dark, neatly combed hair, and intense eyes. He carries himself with an air of authority, though his hands sometimes tremble when stressed.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in the victim's study confronting the victim between 9:00 PM and 10:00 PM.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Claims he was in the garden, tending to his roses, between 9:00 PM and 10:00 PM.
suspects.trueMotive: Financial ruin and betrayal by the victim.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: He is the murderer of Rajan.
suspects.lyingTells: Avoids direct eye contact when discussing his whereabouts during the murder and his financial situation.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows that Anjali is observant and might have seen something, and that Priya has a gambling problem, which could be a motive for her to steal something valuable.

suspects.name: Anjali Sharma
suspects.personality: Shy, observant, and easily intimidated, but has a strong sense of justice.
suspects.physicalDescription: A young woman with dark, shoulder-length hair, large, expressive eyes, and a slender build. She often fidgets with her hands and speaks softly.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was in her room reading from 9:00 PM onwards. Heard a thud from the study around 9:30 PM and saw Vikram Malhotra leaving the study shortly after.
suspects.claimedAlibi: States she was in her room reading a book from 9:00 PM onwards.
suspects.secretTheyreHiding: She saw Vikram Malhotra leaving the study shortly after the estimated time of death but is afraid to say anything.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows that Vikram and Rajan had a heated argument earlier that day. She also suspects Priya has been borrowing money from Rajan.

suspects.name: Priya Kapoor
suspects.personality: Vivacious, materialistic, and a bit reckless. Enjoys the finer things in life.
suspects.physicalDescription: A fashionable woman with striking features, dark hair styled elegantly, and a confident smile. She wears expensive jewelry and is always impeccably dressed.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was at a private auction house across town from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Her attendance can be verified.
suspects.claimedAlibi: Claims she was at a private auction house across town from 8:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
suspects.trueMotive: She owed the victim a significant amount of money from a failed art deal and was desperate to avoid repayment.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: She knows Vikram was in financial trouble and that Anjali seemed unusually nervous after the incident.

suspects.name: Ravi Singh
suspects.personality: Calm, methodical, and discreet. Values order and legality above all else.
suspects.physicalDescription: An older gentleman with greying hair, a distinguished air, and a serious demeanor. He wears spectacles and is always sharply dressed in formal attire.
suspects.trueAlibi: Was at his office working late on a case file until 10:30 PM. His secretary can corroborate this.
suspects.claimedAlibi: States he was at his office working late on a case file until 10:30 PM.
suspects.knowledgeOfOtherSuspects: He knows about the victim's complex financial dealings and was aware of the strain in Vikram's business relationship with the victim.
